# Time-boxed dependency advisory exceptions.
#
# Format: <cargo|ghsa> <advisory-id> <owner> <review-by> <reason>
#
# - cargo: a RustSec advisory (RUSTSEC-YYYY-NNNN) ignored by `cargo audit`.
# - ghsa: a GitHub advisory (GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx) ignored by dependency review.
# - owner: the GitHub user or team accountable for the follow-up.
# - review-by: YYYY-MM-DD; the exception is valid through this date and fails
#   the checks the day after.
# - reason: why the dependency cannot be fixed before the review date.
#
# An exception is not a fix. Remove it as soon as a patched version is in use.
# See SECURITY.md for the triage and exception policy.
#
# No exceptions are currently approved.
